note: The one `sessionpipe trigger add` command that makes a rule again, as `trigger line` prints it and a program reads it back: the flags in one fixed order (--on --topic --event | --every; --when state= for= by=; --subject; --start | --continue; --folder; --level; --tools; --cap; --words); --level and --cap always, the others only when the rule has them; a `when` key's values and the tools joined by a comma, in the rule's order; a value bare when it is not empty, holds only A-Z a-z 0-9 _ . / : @ = + - and does not start with = or -, else in POSIX single quotes with a ' written '\'' and a line feed kept inside them; a value that starts with - written as one word --flag=<value>. `line` is what a person pastes into sh, bash or zsh; `argv` is what it splits into, from `trigger` on. Read back by `add`, it is the same rule, unpaused.

cases.name: a clock rule: --every, the defaults written (--level, --cap), a quote in the words

rule.name: monday-report
rule.words: Make last week's sales report from data/ into reports/.

cases.line: sessionpipe trigger add monday-report --every 'mon 09:00' --start codex --folder '~/work/sales' --level safe --cap 1/day --words 'Make last week'\''s sales report from data/ into reports/.'
argv: Make last week's sales report from data/ into reports/.

cases.name: every flag of a notice rule, in order; lists joined by a comma, in the rule's order
cases.line: sessionpipe trigger add card-todo --on board.example --topic acme/tasks --event record.updated --when 'state=todo,doing' --when for=studio-claude --when 'by=u-41c9,u-7' --subject '^X-[0-9]{1,6}$' --start claude-code --folder '~/work/acme' --level edits --tools 'mcp__board,mcp__board__read' --cap 5/day --words 'Card {subject} is yours and in {state}.'

cases.name: a notice rule with only what it needs: no --event, --when, --subject or --tools
cases.line: sessionpipe trigger add card-min --on board.example --topic acme/tasks --start claude-code --folder '~/work/acme' --level safe --cap 5/day --words 'Card {subject} is yours and in {state}.'

cases.name: a rule that continues a session

rule.name: nightly
rule.words: Make last week's sales report from data/ into reports/.

cases.line: sessionpipe trigger add nightly --every 'day 02:30' --continue codex:019a2b3c-4d5e-7f60-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b --folder '~/work/acme' --level safe --cap 1/day --words 'Make last week'\''s sales report from data/ into reports/.'
argv: Make last week's sales report from data/ into reports/.

cases.name: an interval, a folder with a space and an absolute folder

rule.name: every-2h
rule.words: Make last week's sales report from data/ into reports/.

cases.line: sessionpipe trigger add every-2h --every 2h --start codex --folder '/srv/work/my acme' --level safe --cap 1/day --words 'Make last week'\''s sales report from data/ into reports/.'
argv: Make last week's sales report from data/ into reports/.

cases.name: words with a line feed (kept inside the quotes), a tab and a backslash

rule.name: nl
rule.words:
First line.
Second	line, a \ backslash.

cases.line:
sessionpipe trigger add nl --every 'mon 09:00' --start codex --folder '~/work/sales' --level safe --cap 1/day --words 'First line.
Second	line, a \ backslash.'
argv:
First line.
Second	line, a \ backslash.

cases.name: words a shell would act on, all inside single quotes
cases.line: sessionpipe trigger add shell --every 'mon 09:00' --start codex --folder '~/work/sales' --level safe --cap 1/day --words '$(rm -rf ~) `id` $HOME; echo && x | y > z < w * ? [a] # !! ~'

cases.name: words that start with - are one word: --words=
cases.line: sessionpipe trigger add dash --every 'mon 09:00' --start codex --folder '~/work/sales' --level safe --cap 1/day --words='-h'

cases.name: words that look like a flag of the CLI's own
cases.line: sessionpipe trigger add help --every 'mon 09:00' --start codex --folder '~/work/sales' --level safe --cap 1/day --words='--help --no-color'

cases.name: words that start with = are quoted (zsh expands a bare one)
cases.line: sessionpipe trigger add equals --every 'mon 09:00' --start codex --folder '~/work/sales' --level safe --cap 1/day --words '=TODO'

cases.name: words that are all bare characters stay bare
cases.line: sessionpipe trigger add bare --every 'mon 09:00' --start codex --folder '~/work/sales' --level safe --cap 1/day --words a.b/c:d@e=f+g-h_1

cases.name: a forty-character name and the largest cap

rule.name: a234567890123456789012345678901234567890
rule.words: Make last week's sales report from data/ into reports/.

cases.line: sessionpipe trigger add a234567890123456789012345678901234567890 --every 'mon 09:00' --start codex --folder '~/work/sales' --level read --cap 50/day --words 'Make last week'\''s sales report from data/ into reports/.'
argv: Make last week's sales report from data/ into reports/.
